full_mode_external_dependencies.name: SS928 ACL runtime and NPU driver
full_mode_external_dependencies.probe: ldconfig -p contains libascendcl.so and om_inspect can call aclInit/aclrtSetDevice
full_mode_external_dependencies.redistribution: vendor board image dependency; not bundled

full_mode_external_dependencies.name: vehicle detector OM
full_mode_external_dependencies.probe: SHA256, ACL descriptor and known-image result comparison
full_mode_external_dependencies.redistribution: bundled under AGPL-3.0-only; board ACL validation remains pending

notes: OpenVINO is not an SS928 NPU runtime.
BMI270 initialization blob and WS73 firmware must come from the matching board image or hardware vendor.
Optional GNSS, MT5710, audio and Tsensor failures must not be reported as full-mode success.
